integrity: Analytic proof and standalone symbolic/numerical checker; universal claims are not inferred from finite samples.
scientific_limitations: Two equal nonoverlapping circular arcs, exactly four consecutive modes, fixed half-width between zero and pi/2; global deficit nonsharp except at the optimum where the linear cusp is sharp. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: A sharp linear separation cusp for four-mode Fourier observation on two arcs
